# Open-access full-text fixtures

Three papers used by the `fulltext` tests and by the claim set in
`../verify/fulltext_pairs.json`. All three are published under the
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

| File | Format | Changes |
|---|---|---|
| `PMC10710987.xml` | Europe PMC JATS XML | None (as served by the Europe PMC REST API, 19 October 2026) |
| `PMC10405750.xml` | Europe PMC JATS XML | None (as served by the Europe PMC REST API, 19 October 2026) |
| `arxiv-2504.00406v2-p1-6.pdf` | PDF | Pages 1 to 6 of the arXiv v2 PDF only, recompressed with `pypdf` |

## References (Harvard, Australian style)

Han, J, Buntine, W & Shareghi, E 2025, 'VerifiAgent: a unified verification agent in language model reasoning', arXiv preprint, arXiv:2504.00406v2, viewed 19 October 2026, <https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.00406>.

Teece, AR, Beaven, CM, Argus, CK, Gill, N & Driller, MW 2023, 'Daytime naps improve afternoon power and perceptual measures in elite rugby union athletes: a randomized cross-over trial', *Sleep*, vol. 46, no. 12, zsad133, <https://doi.org/10.1093/sleep/zsad133>.

Wu, C, Deng, J & Gao, C 2023, 'Effects of pre-sleep protein supplementation on plasma markers of muscle damage and inflammatory cytokines resulting from sprint interval training in trained swimmers', *Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition*, vol. 20, no. 1, 2244478, <https://doi.org/10.1080/15502783.2023.2244478>.
